name: MAC Mobility | Basic Learning (rewritten 2026-05-01)
infra_detail: Shared-service mode: EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 already has a real PW peer (RR-SA-2 at 2.2.2.2) and a real EVPN peer (PE-1 at 1.1.1.1). DO NOT provision a Spirent VPLS BGP peer or an extra synthetic EVPN instance. SC01 sources Spirent traffic to PE-4's untagged port-mode AC. SC02 sources Spirent traffic to PE-1's Q-in-Q AC; PE-1 advertises RT-2 to PE-4. SC03 sources Spirent Q-in-Q 215/3001 traffic to RR-SA-2's bundle-100.2001 AC through DNAAS; RR-SA-2 forwards to PE-4 via the existing PW (label 1032269).
rewrite_rationale: Old recipe relied on auto-discovered evpn_name + auto-picked si_outer_vlan; on PE-4 this resolved to EVPN_SI_AC_PW_test (VPLS_SI_ONLY, ge100-18/0/0.4006) and VLAN 219, which is the wrong service.

Correct topology: EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 is the cross-PE service shared by PE-1 (ge400-0/0/5.4001 Q-in-Q 214/4001), PE-4 (ge100-18/0/1 untagged port-mode, fabric VLAN 211), RR-SA-2 (bundle-100.2001 reached through Spirent Q-in-Q 215/3001; B-15 swaps to DUT wire outer 4 inner 3001).
PW learning is tested by sending traffic to RR-SA-2's AC; the VPLS PW (label 1032269, peer 2.2.2.2) carries it to PE-4 -- PE-4 sees it as v>. No need for a synthetic VPLS stream on PE-4 itself.
Every show command and Spirent stream is validated up-front via dnos_cmd_search + dnos_dnaas_teach_plan. No auto-discovery surprises at runtime.

e2e._comment: Declarative mapping consumed by scaler/TEST/shared/recipe_to_dnos_e2e.py to emit a cheetah dnos_e2e (mcDNOS) pytest. The lab recipe (DNAAS/Q-in-Q/VPLS-PW label 1032269/Spirent) cannot be replicated verbatim on containers; this block declares the BEHAVIORAL equivalent that proves the same L>/B>/v> learning + RT-2 + no-suppression + no-ghost outcomes on mcDNOS in CI. Modeled 1:1 on tests/suites/dnos_e2e/tests/test_bgp_evpn_mcdnos.py.

scenarios.note: Software ArpPingFloodDNOS from mcdnos1 floods SA1 local AC; SA1 must learn L> on the AC interface and advertise RT-2 to mcdnos2.
mcdnos2 learns the MAC locally and advertises RT-2; SA1 (DUT) must install it with B> source and remote-PE nexthop.

scenarios.reason: VPLS-PW Seamless-Integration depends on bgp-vpls label-block carving (see known bug SW-253359 on clusters) and a real PW peer; not faithfully reproducible on a single-container mcDNOS. Cover v> via the CDNOS SI suite (src/tests/cdnos/tests/test_bgp_evpn_seamless_integration.py) or keep lab-only via Spirent.

scenarios.note: On mcDNOS the coexistence check covers L>+B> (v> is lab_only); same no-ghost / no-suppression / BGP-stable gates apply.

traffic.rationale: backend=arpping -> ArpPingFloodDNOS (software, mcDNOS/CI). backend=otg -> ArpPingFloodSpirent + traffic_generator_config (SA+Spirent lab). Same validations either way.

service_capabilities.rationale: EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 is BOTH_RTS on PE-4 (export-l2vpn-evpn + export-l2vpn-vpls), shared with PE-1 via EVPN RT and RR-SA-2 via VPLS-SI RT. The other instances on PE-4 are partial (VPLS_SI_ONLY or NO_RTS) and would fail rt2_advertised on SC01.

expected_in_basic_learning.L>: Locally learned via this AC (egress = local AC interface). Source for SC01.
expected_in_basic_learning.B>: Remotely learned via BGP EVPN RT-2 from a remote PE. Source for SC02.
expected_in_basic_learning.v>: Remotely learned via VPLS PW (Seamless-Integration). Source for SC03.
expected_in_basic_learning.M: Seamless-Integration MAC (informational, not a fail flag)

forbidden_in_basic_learning.F: Frozen / suppressed (loop-prevention triggered) -- never expected on a clean SC01-SC04
forbidden_in_basic_learning.D: Down / blackhole -- never expected; indicates AC blocking-all or sticky LLP shutdown
forbidden_in_basic_learning.s: Stale -- only acceptable transiently during BGP convergence; fail if persistent

mac_flag_legend.rationale: Source flags (L> / B> / v>) prove WHO learned the MAC. Status flags (F/D/s) prove HEALTH. Forbidden flags failing the test indicates a real problem (suppression, blocking-all, or stale state).

prerequisites.rationale: EVPN_ONLY would fail SC03 (no VPLS RT, no PW). VPLS_SI_ONLY would fail SC01 (no native EVPN RT, no RT-2 advertised).
PE-4's AC for EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 must be ge100-18/0/1 (the untagged port-mode AC). Other instances (e.g. EVPN_SI_AC_PW_test using ge100-18/0/0.4006) are NOT this test.

scenarios.name: SC03: v> VPLS PW -- RR-SA-2 learns MAC locally on its AC; PE-4 sees it via VPLS PW (label 1032269)
scenarios.test_design_note: PE-4's PW peer (2.2.2.2) is RR-SA-2. We send Spirent Q-in-Q 215/3001 traffic to RR-SA-2's bundle-100.2001 AC through DNAAS; RR-SA-2 learns L> locally and the EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 service uses Seamless-Integration BGP-VPLS to forward the MAC to PE-4 via PW (not RT-2). PE-4 sees v>. This avoids the brittle 'send MPLS-labeled VPLS stream' approach and exercises the real PW datapath.
